scene: The spun globe projects three shimmering transit portals along the shop floor.
picture: Side-view along a chequered floor. On the far left, a tiny red double-decker bus idles with open doors. Left of centre stands the boy holding his skateboard beside the spun globe. In the centre, a rope-bridge lift basket sways gently. On the far right, a paddle steamer bobs in a tiled canal basin.
shown: a miniature red double-decker bus waiting on the far left floor
a dangling wooden rope-bridge lift basket hovering in the centre
a whistling toy paddle steamer floating inside a water basin far right
